_note: Baseline source queue. Ingest with: python3 pipeline/ingest.py --url ... --type article|video|podcast|book --title ... --author ...
_note_js_rendered: Sites marked js_rendered=true return almost no text via scraper. Copy article text manually then: pbpaste | python3 pipeline/ingest.py --stdin --type article --title '...' --author '...'
